edits.new:
And a rule evaluated in RWB-S9-E6032-APP is named there as evaluated by that story

  Scenario: AC8 A redelivered consumed event changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the override of the placement to "PRT-SYN-0034-B" has been consumed once from "rwb.partner.InstructionIssued.v1"
    When the same event is delivered again
    Then no second instruction is created for the case
    And GET /api/recovery/decision/v1/decision-log?caseId={caseId} still holds two entries
    And the instruction still answers "PRT-SYN-0034-B"

  Scenario: AC9 A consumed call that fails or does not answer changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the override of the placement to "PRT-SYN-0034-B" with the reason held in the fixture is consumed
    When the call to POST /api/recovery/partner/v1/cases/{caseId}/instructions fails or does not answer
    Then the harness asserts only the published status codes
    And no third entry is written to the decision log
    When the override is replayed with the same Idempotency-Key
    Then one instruction exists for the case and the decision log still holds two entries
